decisions.reason: Displaying help text on both the label and inside the field does not change the requirement to preserve Title field formatting.
The source specifies where help text appears but does not change the existing behavior that in-field text is removed when the field becomes active.
Adding help text to the label and field neither resolves nor changes the separate requirement for grey visual input cues.
The help-text location decision does not select or alter the robust technical mechanism required for standard text placeholders.
The source does not change the checklist control type or its behavior.
The source does not change the dropdown control or its Bestyrelsesmode scope.
Displaying help text in two locations does not change the calendar-style date input method.
The source concerns interactive-field help text, not the master template's theme colors.
The source does not affect automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
The references to labels and fields do not alter bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, or appearance.
The interactive-field label in the source is unrelated to the stored heading and image/table caption typography rules.
The help-text placement decision does not affect manual line-break entry after pasting legacy content.
